evidence_quotes.O: When I got it, I did a test with my camera on a tripod. I took several pairs of comparison shots.
evidence_quotes.C: After each use, I remove a battery, so there is no drain. I didn't think a plain old battery could last so long.
evidence_quotes.E: I posted the images for photographer friends to see, and they came to the same conclusion:
evidence_quotes.A: Some people mentioned difficulty inserting the SD card. It's no problem at all if you hold it by the sides and insert it with the label facing you.
evidence_quotes.N: I tried it just now, and gave up after eight minutes.
